description: Hi, I am Meera. I bake eggless cakes and cupcakes from my home kitchen in Baner, Pune. Started 3 years back for friends and family, now taking orders from all over Pune. Everything is made fresh to order, no preservatives, I use real butter and Belgian chocolate. Custom birthday and anniversary cakes with photo print or theme toppers also possible. Please order at least 2 days before. Pickup from Baner or delivery within 10 km (delivery charge extra). Orders on WhatsApp mostly, 10am to 8pm. Closed Tuesdays.
